value: General Services Administration / federal contracting agencies (FAR); Department of Defense (DFARS/CMMC) for defense construction contractors; OSHA (safety; no cyber rules)
FAR 52.204-21 / CMMC Level 1 (escalating to NIST SP 800-171 R2 / CMMC Level 2 when CUI is handled)

Construction has no sector-specific cyber regulation; the binding obligations most firms face come through federal contracts. The 15 FAR requirements are the minimum; firms handling CUI (e.g., controlled building plans for federal/defense facilities) must meet DFARS 7012/NIST SP 800-171 R2 and CMMC Level 2.
Federal Contract Information (FCI); CUI incl. controlled building/facility drawings; Employee PII and payroll (certified payroll/Davis-Bacon); Bid and pricing data; Client facility security details
Project management and BIM/CAD platforms; ERP/accounting and payroll; Building automation/BAS installed for clients; Telematics for heavy equipment; Video surveillance and access control installs
Not a CISA critical infrastructure sector; CIRCIA would reach construction firms only via another criterion (e.g., DFARS 7012 contractor). SEC cross-cutting note in n11.
